title: Boeing KC-46A Everett production line: Phase 56F Coverage Decision
summary: GAO reports 173 procured and 101 delivered aircraft as of January 2026 and identifies still-missing required assets. Phase 56F decision: A current procured-versus-delivered program denominator is closed; Everett monthly due dates, quality, and rework remain unavailable.
key_findings: Highest-value missing record: Procured, due, delivered, and accepted aircraft under one current denominator.
Remaining gap: Monthly due and accepted aircraft, rework, quality escapes, labor, modification hours, cost, and deficiency closure.
why_it_matters: The coverage decision prevents broad context from displacing the one operating or closure record that would materially deepen the named entity.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves the stable entity ID manufacturer-boeing-kc46-everett.
Separates current evidence from the missing record.
Names the exact condition that can reopen the decision.
evidence_limits: Program-level procurement, delivery, deficiency, and schedule records do not expose Everett monthly due dates, labor, rework, yield, quality escapes, or causal effects.
Monthly due and accepted aircraft, rework, quality escapes, labor, modification hours, cost, and deficiency closure.
No causal effect, ranking, composite score, readiness score, or unsupported cross-entity comparison is supported.
